title: Frozen-rule scalar retention: plug-in CLT with a consistent influence-function variance
statement: Conditional on a frozen provider s_hat and rule q, for an iid equally weighted evaluation sample with true scalar scores S_i and labels Z_i = q(s_hat(X_i)), the uncentred plug-in ratio eta_hat = sum_b m_hat_b^2/p_hat_b / v_hat (0/0 := 0 on empty cells) equals 1 - RSS/TSS exactly and satisfies sqrt(n)(eta_hat - eta) -> N(0, sigma^2) with sigma^2 = E[psi^2], psi = ((1-eta) S^2 - (S - c_Z)^2)/v, c_b = m_b/p_b, which carries the numerator-denominator covariance. The plug-in sigma_hat^2 = mean(psi_hat_i^2) is strongly consistent and sum_i psi_hat_i = 0 exactly; the Wald interval eta_hat +/- z sigma_hat/sqrt(n) has asymptotic level 1 - alpha whenever sigma^2 > 0. sigma^2 = 0 iff S given Z=b is supported on the roots of (s - c_b)^2 = (1 - eta) s^2 for every b with p_b > 0: for 0 < eta < 1 the roots are c_b/(1 -+ sqrt(1 - eta)) (at most two atoms per cell, one when c_b = 0), with the upper-root weight eta/(2(1 + sqrt(1 - eta))) forced by the mean and such laws exist; at eta = 1 the root is c_b; at eta = 0 the equation is the identity and every law with vanishing cell means has sigma^2 = 0, atomless or not. Where sigma^2 = 0 the interval is unsupported (measured: conservative, width O(1/n)). The interval is for the true retention Var(E[s | q(s_hat)])/Var(s); the proxy surrogate's population value is a different number and is excluded with probability -> 1.
assumptions: A1: every cell has positive population probability under the evaluation law
A2: the true scalar score has a finite fourth moment under the evaluation law (automatic for bounded scores, e.g. mixture-fraction scores at interior reference points)
A3: positive unbinned second moment E[S^2] > 0 (all-zero scores are refused by the library)

A4: sigma^2 > 0. Hardened by the audit: sigma^2 > 0 holds automatically iff eta > 0 and S | Z=b is atomless on some cell of positive probability; at eta = 0 every law (atomless included) has sigma^2 = 0, and for 0 < eta < 1 sigma^2 = 0 exactly for the two-atom-per-cell laws with the forced weights (CE-O6-ETA-ZERO-MULTIATOM-VARIANCE-001 and the two-atom law in the audit)

the rule, provider, training data, reference point and K are frozen; the evaluation sample is independent of them, iid, equally weighted, and scores are never centred; q o s_hat is a fixed measurable map, which is what makes the (S, Z) pairs iid and satisfies the fixed-in-theta hypothesis of FI-QUANT-IDENTITY

the retained-information reading of eta requires the evaluation law to be the reference law P_theta0 (so E[S] = 0 and E[S^2] = I_full); under any other evaluation law the interval estimates the uncentred second-moment ratio of S on Z under that law, which is not a Fisher retention; the CLT itself never uses E[S] = 0

the delta method is applied to the estimator's own functional phi(p, m, v) = sum_{b: p_b > 0} m_b^2/p_b / v (phi := 0 at v = 0), defined on all of R^{2K+1} and equal to the smooth g near theta, so no separate empty-cell transfer step is needed; the union-bound transfer in the prose is also complete
sigma_hat^2 -> sigma^2 almost surely: finitely many strong laws for within-cell moments of order <= 4 plus continuity at the limit; empty cells are a.s. transient by Borel-Cantelli under A1

first-order statement only: no finite-sample or uniform rare-cell coverage guarantee; measured O(1/n) bias and n = 100 under-coverage (0.913-0.918 at the rung 15, 0.896 at the rung 300) are recorded in O6.7 and the audit

proof_location.section: O6. Frozen-rule scalar retention: plug-in asymptotics and a consistent variance

role: the frozen-rule, scalar, oracle-score special case of OP27; separates evaluation uncertainty from proxy bias
warning: Bridge from the delta method (van der Vaart Thm 3.1; Serfling Sec. 3.3; Cramer Ch. 28) with the influence-function variance (Hampel et al. 1986). Independently audited 5 Sep 2026 (AUDITS/AUDIT-SCORE-ORACLE-ROBUSTNESS-001.md): O6.1-O6.3 and the Wald statement verified in exact arithmetic and by fresh-seed replication; the sigma^2 = 0 characterisation was wrong at eta = 0 and is hardened as recorded in A4. The closed-form psi, the RSS identity and the root characterisation are project algebra within a textbook method: prior art for the method, search gap (not novelty) for the exact fixed-partition uncentred statement. Does not resolve OPEN-RETENTION-UNCERTAINTY (vector scores, refitted rules, weights, no oracle, the degenerate limit when sigma^2 = 0) or OPEN-SCORE-PERTURBATION. Not a library feature: no public uncertainty API exists.
